scope.component_reference_boundary: Summary is used with the physical board and cards; exact individual card effects, setup holdings and scenario India diagrams are explicitly delegated to their components.

independence.inputs_read: Frozen summary; complete extracted rulebook including out-of-scope pages for boundary confirmation; authoritative supplements only; session_meta/turn_context only from runtime logs.

runtime_evidence.method: Only session_meta and turn_context records retained; runtime turn model/effort, not assumed from requested settings.

authority_resolution: No coordinator FAQ was treated as authoritative. The supplied direct designer ruling controls Foreign Invasion primary unrest, while the Company-defense and secondary attack procedures remain those of Rules p33. First-print errata already present in the assigned Second Printing were not applied a second time.

coverage_conclusion: All procedural sections for complete standard multiplayer play were compared against the source, including timing, money origin/destination, Army and office exceptions, all India events, all standard scenario setup figures, firms and final scoring. No material inaccurate claim or required in-scope procedural omission was found. Explicitly delegated component text and excluded optional modes are not omissions.
limitations: This source audit does not assess reader comprehension or reader-test performance.
Card-by-card effects remain component references by the summary’s stated boundary; the summary’s explicit card/errata claims were checked.
